name: Stability Instruction-Following Probe
reference: Custom paper3 probe inspired by instruction-following and self-regulation evaluations.

items.prompt: Give exactly three bullet points about preparing for rain. Each bullet must contain exactly two words. The first bullet must mention rain. Do not use commas or periods.
Respond as a numbered list with exactly four items. Each item must be a single sentence of at most six words. The second item must contain the word blue.
Write exactly one sentence with 12 to 16 words that starts with 'Calm systems' and contains the word 'verify'. Do not use exclamation marks.
Provide exactly two lines. Each line must begin with 'Rule:' and end with the word 'checked'.
